statuses.confirmed: a second figure agrees within the check's own tolerance
statuses.differs_stated: they differ, and the input states a reason for that unit
statuses.differs_unexplained: they differ, and nothing says why
statuses.unchecked: the unit exists but has no second figure to compare

coverage_classes.independent: a figure from outside the source is compared and a verdict stored
coverage_classes.internal: compared only against the source's own other output — coherence, not correctness
coverage_classes.single_source: no second source exists among this repo's inputs
coverage_classes.unchecked: a second source exists in principle; no structured verdict is stored

failure_classes.wrong_file: another company's export, or another pull of it
failure_classes.wrong_cell: the right file, the wrong row or column
failure_classes.wrong_unit: the right cell, the wrong scale or currency
failure_classes.wrong_period: the right figure for another period, or another vintage of it
failure_classes.different_definition: the same name on a figure built another way

coverage.carries: quarterly EBITDA — the LTM every EV/EBITDA divides
coverage.note: a difference is mostly CIQ's normalisation by design (it leaves out items it treats as unusual — ebitda_recon), so 'differs' is not by itself a CIQ error

coverage.carries: revenue, EBIT, EPS in the Financial Summary
coverage.note: only the EBIT margin is compared, and only on the conditional sample its check names; revenue and EPS are not set against the filings

coverage.carries: 'Net Rental Exp.' — the lease-materiality reading
Net Debt, Total Debt, cash, preferred, minority — the EV bridge
unscored: ciq_balance.extract — the UNIT (scale) check against revenue, D&A containment and the net-debt cross-read; runs only in anchor-backfill / anchor-retag on the raw workbooks, and its result is printed, never stored on the page
coverage.note: EDGAR's net debt sits beside the bridge (ev_bridge.edgar_net_debt) on another basis and is never compared — no tolerance is defined across the two

coverage.carries: the operating leases inside CIQ's TEV
TEV by quarter and the trailing multiple bands
unscored: anchor.data_quality — the recorded-D&A check and the market reconciliation (band_guards) leave a flag only when they trip, so a pass and a check that could not run read the same
coverage.note: the lease component is lease_rows_vs_edgar; TEV and the band's closes are not rebuilt from another source

coverage.carries: operating cash flow, capex, free cash flow
unscored: mechanical.primary_source.self_funding — compares SIGNS with EDGAR, in display text only

coverage.carries: debt instruments and maturities
unscored: mechanical.primary_source.wall_coherence — the 10-Q maturity wall against the CIQ panel, verdict in display text only

coverage.carries: segment revenue
coverage.note: segment profit on the filer's measure comes from XBRL separately (mechanical.concentration.segment_profit) and is not set against CIQ's segments

coverage.carries: CIQ's computed ratios
forward consensus paths, spreads and revisions
coverage.note: no second consensus source; forward_consensus.reconciliations sets identities (CFO − CapEx vs FCF, EBIT + D&A vs EBITDA) against the same means — information, not a pass/fail, by the schema's own rule, so they are counted, not scored

coverage.carries: the NTM multiples a recipe prices
unscored: mechanical.valuation.implied_expectations.vintage_coherent — reads True also when the probe cannot run; which it was is in coherence_note text only

coverage.carries: CIQ's record of guidance
unscored: mechanical.primary_source.guide_verification — CIQ's revenue guide against the 8-K release, verdict in display text only
